meta.name: mcp-cli
meta.description: Interface for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers via CLI. Use when you need to interact with external tools, APIs, or data sources through MCP servers.

copy.tagline: 通过命令行调用外部工具与数据源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要通过命令行使用MCP服务器连接外部服务。
copy.tagline_en: Call external tools and data sources via command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to interact with external tools and APIs through MCP servers via CLI.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过命令行与 MCP 服务器交互，连接到 GitHub、文件系统、数据库等外部工具和 API。它会执行 mcp-cli 命令来列出服务器、查看工具详情、调用工具并获取结果。
howto.when: 当你需要访问外部系统（如 GitHub、文件系统、数据库）或调用其工具时触发，例如查询数据、读写文件或调用 API。

say.text: 列出所有可用的 MCP 服务器和工具。
say.note: Claude 会运行 mcp-cli 命令并显示列表。

say.text: 看看文件系统服务器有哪些工具可以用。
帮我调用文件系统读取 README.md 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can interact with MCP servers via command line, connecting to external tools and APIs like GitHub, filesystems, databases. It runs mcp-cli commands to list servers, view tool details, call tools, and retrieve results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to access external systems (e.g., GitHub, filesystem, database) or call their tools, such as querying data, reading/writing files, or invoking APIs.

say_en.text: List all available MCP servers and tools.
say_en.note: Claude runs mcp-cli and shows the list.

say_en.text: Show what tools the filesystem server has.
say_en.note: Claude runs mcp-cli info filesystem to see tools and parameters.

say_en.text: Call the filesystem server to read README.md.
say_en.note: Claude constructs and runs mcp-cli call to read the file.
